nodes.natural_language: Tim is doing a cakewalk with $11$ steps. He takes his first step on step $1$ and takes a total of $139$ steps, walking in a circle (so that after the 11th step he reaches the first step again). Which step of the cakewalk does he end on? Show that it is 7.
